name: Rating Crystals
description: A rating made of snow crystals that grow richer from the first to the fifth.

props.name: value
props.description: The rating, from 0 (none) to max. Controlled; pair with onChange.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when a crystal is chosen by click, tap or the arrow keys.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of positions. Each position holds a richer crystal than the one before: a bare six-arm star, then side branches, then plates at the centre and the tips.

props.name: size
props.description: Width and height of each crystal in pixels. Drawn to stay clear at 24.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label for the group. Without it, pass aria-label.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Shows the rating without letting it change; no hover preview.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the group. Other react-aria-components RadioGroup props, such as isDisabled and name, are passed through.
